g.text: An airfoil pressure difference produces lift; angle of attack changes lift until stall

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Assigned low-speed teaching model, not an actual airfoil polar or CFD result. Pressure difference integrates toCL0.86 at the illustrated6° operating point
under the thin-section pressure-lift approximation. The separate CL curve rises linearly to an assigned stall onset12° then declines; real stall depends on
geometry, Reynolds number, roughness, and history. Drag vector gives direction only, not a calculated drag coefficient.
